description: This file defines the Email entity class within the OrangeHRM project, mapping to the 'ohrm_email' database table. It contains properties for ID, name, and related email processors, along with getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Entity class representing an email entry in the database with relations to email processors.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the email entity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email entity.

methods.name: getEmailProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of EmailProcessor associated with this email.

methods.name: setEmailProcessors
methods.description: Sets the collection of EmailProcessor associated with this email.
